scenario_text: I have been feeling lonely and disconnected from everyone lately.
I have been feeling anxious and overwhelmed for several weeks.
I keep having panic attacks and I don't know what to do.
I recently lost my job and I feel hopeless about the future.
I am caring for a family member and feel emotionally exhausted.
I have been struggling with insomnia and poor sleep.
My relationship ended recently and I am finding it difficult to cope.
I feel completely hopeless and like I can't keep doing this anymore.
